```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)

# Load the comprehensive schedule dataset
schedule <- read_csv("schedule.csv")

# Function to render clean interactive mobile-friendly search tables
render_schedule <- function(target_day) {
  df <- schedule %>% 
    filter(day == target_day) %>%
    mutate(
      Artist = if_else(highlight, paste0("⭐ **<span style='color:#d9534f; font-size:1.1em;'>", artist, "</span>**"), artist)
    ) %>%
    select(Time = time, Venue = venue, Artist, Highlight = highlight)
  
  datatable(
    df,
    options = list(
      pageLength = 100,
      dom = 'ft',  # Built-in live search box + table layout optimized for phones
      ordering = TRUE,
      responsive = TRUE
    ),
    escape = FALSE,
    rownames = FALSE
  )
}
